metadata.case_name: KO FUNG v. PHYSICAL BEAUTY CENTRE (CENTRAL) LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: one of its customers (customer of the 1st Defendant's Centre)

source: Examination by Dr. Wong revealed rectangular erythematous area with blister on the left side of her face. Dr. Wong diagnosed the Plaintiff to have suffered from scald injury.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified superficial injury of part of head

injuries.description: left mid cheek rectangular patch of permanent scarring due to burning injury
source: Dr. King considered that she suffered from left mid cheek rectangular patch of permanent scarring due to burning injury. Dr. King took the view that her scar is permanent although further treatment may improve the appearance of the scar or improve the degree of scarring.

manifestations.description: rectangular erythematous area with blister on the left side of her face.
After 8 sessions of treatment, the Plaintiff’s skin lesion was healed leaving a superfacial, pigmented scar.
left mid cheek rectangular patch of permanent scarring due to burning injury.

treatments_received: Consulted a private dermatologist, Dr. Wong Kwok On; Examination revealed rectangular erythematous area with blister on the left side of her face.
After 8 sessions of treatment, the Plaintiff’s skin lesion was healed leaving a superfacial, pigmented scar.
Consulted another dermatologist, Dr. Tinny Ho for treatment of her scar.
Examined by medical expert Dr. Walter King, plastic surgeon.
treatments_future: various treatments recommended by Dr. Walter King (The estimated costs are in the region of $99,000).

losses.description: left mid cheek rectangular patch of permanent scarring due to burning injury; 3% cosmetic disability.
